title: SPB: A Surplus-Preserving Bargaining Protocol for LLM Multi-Agent Negotiation - code and data
description:
Code, episode-level data, complete transcripts and analysis scripts for a controlled study of communication protocols in LLM bargaining. The package contains the five-protocol engine (free dialogue, alternating offers, sealed bid, SPB, SPB+), the 1,500-episode DeepSeek experiment, a 315-episode cross-vendor replication (Qwen3-32B, GLM-4.5-Air), the 42-episode hand-audited outcome labels, and the transcript adjudicator used to measure free-dialogue outcomes without regex parsing.

Code is MIT-licensed; the data files (episodes, transcripts, audit labels) are released under CC BY 4.0.
